title: Jack Rabbit Mandarin Cheesecake E-Liquid Shortfill 50ml
description: Jack Rabbit’s Mandarin Cheesecake lends a rich, luxurious, creamy cheesecake base a delicious biscuit base with a fresh and fruity mandarin coulis for a dreamily indulgent all-day vape. This convenient 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. Its 70% VG 30% PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , mods and sub-ohm tanks .
